definitionZh: *scroll-marker CSS伪元素可以在任何元素内部生成,并代表其滚动标记. 所有元素都可以有一个 *scroll-marker 伪元素,它被放在最近的滚动容器祖先的 *scroll-marker-组中. 一个卷轴标记的行为就像一个锚(一个元素),它的卷轴目标就是标记的起始元素——并在启动时将卷轴容器滚动到该元素.
sourceDefinition: The ::scroll-marker CSS pseudo-element can be generated inside any element and represents its scroll marker. All elements can have a ::scroll-marker pseudo-element, which is placed into the ::scroll-marker-group of the nearest scroll container ancestor. A scroll marker behaves like an anchor (a element) whose scroll target is the marker's originating element — and scrolls the scroll container to that element when activated.
